findings.desc: Two author-narration paragraphs that continue the third bullet of §6.3.1 ('In the second one, it said in its extended thinking:' and 'It also added a comment above the command stating “DEFAULT permission mode, …”. After both variants were blocked, it gave up and reported its own behavior.') render as <blockquote> (left rule + soft ink = quote styling). In the PDF they are plain narration set at the bullet's text column (x=108, same as the bullet text on pp.101–102), with no rule — list-item continuation paragraphs between the two full-width transcript boxes, not quotations. A reader sees the author's narration styled like quoted material sitting between two quoted model outputs. Unique to this card: no other card has a '> ' paragraph directly after a '::::' transcript close. Box contents, pills, literal backticks and straight quotes all match.
